convert_swin_checkpoint: convert a Swin Transformer v1 checkpoint to mmdet format using swin_converter
run_swin_converter_cli: run the swinv1_to_mmdet CLI to convert src checkpoint to dst mmdet-style checkpoint
transform_checkpoint_keys: transform checkpoint keys from swin backbone.layers to mmdet stages naming convention
load_and_save_checkpoint: load a checkpoint with CheckpointLoader and save converted weights with torch.save
rename_swin_weights: rename swin attn and mlp weight keys to mmdet w_msa and ffn naming style
